Technological growth needs space to happen but research in this area can be misguided and exaggerated. Media portrayals of the possible risks make them more salient to the public but sensationalized ideas about the future do not accurately predict what the actual risks will be and therefore should not influence public policy. This influence on the public draws lawmakers' attention away from pressing problems and toward managing speculative issues that will not end up being as dangerous as the ones that we know exist.
